I'm an old farmer, 62 years now. Been working this land since I was 22, so I know every corner of my 10.9 mu. I didn't go to school much — just primary — but I know farming from doing it, not from books. My household has 7 mouths, though a couple of my sons work in the factory in Handan and send some money home. That helps, but I still can't spend too much on inputs. Cash is tight.

I divide my land like this: about 8 mu I do wheat-maize double crop, that's my bread and butter. The other 2.9 mu I plant cotton, been doing that for years. The cotton brings decent money but needs lots of hand work.

**Wheat** — I plant around October 10th, same time as everyone in the village. I use the improved seed from the shop in town, not the fancy hybrid stuff, costs about 40 yuan per mu. For fertilizer, I put down a base of compound fertilizer before planting, about 40-45 kg per mu, then at jointing time if the wheat looks yellow I topdress with urea, maybe 10-12 kg per mu. Total nitrogen works out to about 15 kg per mu. I irrigate 3 times — once before winter to help it settle, once at jointing when it's warming up, and once at grain filling if it's dry. Pumping costs money so I don't overdo it. I spray herbicide once after planting, and maybe one insecticide if I see aphids. My family does the work, takes about 5 days per mu. I expect around 400 kg per mu if the weather behaves. Last year I got 420, so I'll say 400 to be safe.

**Maize** — This is planted right after wheat harvest in mid-June, sometimes within 3-4 days if I'm lucky with the weather. Very tight window. I buy hybrid seed, about 2.5 kg per mu, costs around 45 yuan per mu. I broadcast fertilizer at planting, compound plus some urea, total nitrogen about 13 kg per mu. I irrigate twice if it's dry — once right after planting to help it sprout, and once at the big ear stage. Maize doesn't need as much water as wheat. One herbicide spray and maybe one insecticide for the corn borer. Family labor about 4 days per mu. I hope for 430 kg per mu.

**Cotton** — I plant mid-to-late April. I use the improved seed I know, about 55 yuan per mu. Cotton needs less nitrogen than grain crops, I put about 11 kg N per mu, mostly compound fertilizer. I irrigate twice, and I have to spray more pesticide — herbicide at the start, then insecticide 3-4 times for bollworm, that's the big problem. Cotton needs lots of picking labor. My wife and I do what we can, but at harvest time I hire some help for picking, about 4 days per mu at 100 yuan a day. Family puts in about 12 days per mu. Yield should be around 260 kg per mu of seed cotton.

I watch my costs carefully. Total spending on seeds, fertilizer, water, pesticide, and hired labor comes to about 4,800 yuan. I could spend more, but then I'd have no cash if someone gets sick. My neighbor Lao Wang uses more fertilizer but he has a bigger farm and his son drives a tractor. I can't copy him. I do what works for me.
